revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2024-25 growth was 4.5%/3.2%; modest housing-market recovery, mid-single-digit growth fading to ~3.5%, near nominal GDP

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 12.7% (20,890/164,683), FY2023 14.2%; assume slight recovery to 12.8%

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate = 1-14,156/18,602 = ~23.9%; used 24.5% as a conservative blend with federal 21% plus state taxes

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.56 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 11.8%; beta = Damodaran Retail (Building Supply) cash-corrected unlevered 1.318 relevered at D/E 0.233 and 21% tax; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran), after-tax ~4.2%; weights 81%/19% (Damodaran industry D/E, no share price available) = ~10.4%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 55,772 (LT debt incl. current 46,341+4,967 + commercial paper 4,464) - cash 1,389; acc. 0001628280-26-019436. Note: the concept used may include some finance leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 995,000,000 (acc. 0001628280-26-019436), in millions
